public_api: qualify_and_ingest(candidate, *, binding, policy, resolve_assessment, ingest, now)
trusted_ports: Explicit caller-injected server-owned callable; no task-payload fallback
output: Exact keys {qualification, ingest_result}; qualification equals accepted F110 output; ingest_result is callback return object or None
rules: Require callable(resolve_assessment) and callable(ingest) before any port call, else RuntimeQualificationError("TRUSTED_PORT_REQUIRED")
resolve_assessment(deepcopy(candidate)) exactly once; never accept assessment from metadata/task flags
qualify_candidate(candidate, assessment, binding=binding, policy=policy, now=now) exact accepted call
Only verdict QUALIFIED_FOR_PREPARATION calls ingest(deepcopy(candidate), qualification=deepcopy(qualification)) once
NEEDS_REVIEW and NOT_QUALIFIED return ingest_result None and zero ingest calls
Propagate exact accepted dependency/resolver/ingest exception object, including DuplicateLead; do not turn error into review/success
No mutation of candidate/binding/policy/assessment; qualify inputs must be snapshots to protect callers from injected ports
error_class: RuntimeQualificationError(ValueError): code attribute, str(error)==code; no input echo
integration_mapping: reference/qualification_binding_mapper.py frozen integration-owner mechanical map; direct projection binding INVALID_SCHEMA
